lessonsLearned: Weekend windows can have no announced arXiv submissions; check announcement schedule rather than treating 0 as an outage.
candidate-demo-001 already lives in data/candidates/2026-10-16.json; candidate IDs must be unique across files, so it is kept there and not duplicated.
Hugging Face createdAt can predate an announcement (Reflection Beam, StepFun); use it to filter pre-window releases.
